correctness.rationale: In the universal normal form Q²=xyz(x+y+z), exactly seven bitangents arise as square restrictions. The cross term of each restricted binary quadratic vanishes precisely for contact 4P; the seven coefficients are e,f,d,e+f,d+f,d+e,d+e+f. They form all nonzero F2-linear forms on (d,e,f), so hyperflex count is 2^(3-r)-1 and a dimension-two kernel forms a Fano pencil. Smoothness is the explicit seven nonvanishing gradient exclusions; over infinite algebraic closure each span-rank choice admits parameters a,b,c off finitely many proper hypersurfaces. Independent GF8 enumeration confirms 512 triples and rank histogram 1,49,294,168; finite checks not the proof of existence for all algebraically closed k.
